# Justin S. Henriksen

> Founder & CEO of GetLatest AI and Fenix Venture. Former Microsoft Sr. Director. A fractional AI leader who helps companies adopt AI and ship it into production.

Justin has been building software since 2004 - as an engineer, architect, general manager, and founder. He led Microsoft's partner ecosystem for AI, data, and advanced analytics, ran P&Ls up to $51M, and now builds AI products at GetLatest AI while taking on fractional AI leadership engagements.

## Facts
- Current role: Founder & CEO, GetLatest AI and Fenix Venture (since June 2024)
- Former roles: Microsoft Sr. Director, Partner Ecosystem (2017-2021); CEO/GM at Crayon US; CEO/President at Blue Eye
- Education: MBA, University of Utah; BA Computer Science, Weber State University
- Focus areas: enterprise AI strategy, AI governance, cloud architecture, fractional AI leadership
